race.comment: ADMIRE ASTRA (2) led them up over a mile on resumption in an easier race, though she turned in a good figure there and improvement is on the cards as she stretches in distance. May need some luck from the draw, but O'Donnell replaces the apprentice hoop and she can go one better. BILLIONAIRE'S ROW (3) won well fresh before remaining at 1400m last start and finishing 2.4L off the winner. Out to 1800m now third-up looks a good move, and she's a third-up winner in the past. Has upside and can land the knockout blow again. IHTSAKING (6) was another Durrant runner off a big break, finishing 1.1L off the winner last start after being 822 days between horses. Nottle sticks with him and with this shaping nicely from the draw, he can be there at the finish. I'M NIPOTE (4) got the job done last start and the rise in trip won't be an issue. Can repeat the dose. LATE ARRIVAL (1) can go one better stepping up in distance.
